caseName: City of New York v. United States Department of Transportation
caseNameFull: City of New York v. United States Department of Transportation

opinions.text:
Appeal from C. A. 2d Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice Rehnquist took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
